answer: Make every payout cross a bridge with a toll paid in time: rewards vest and unlock slowly, so an identity reaches its earnings zenith only after many epochs of consistent, peer-verified work. Anchor each identity to that public vesting history so anyone can check how long it has been earning honestly. A sybil farm can mint a thousand fresh identities, but each starts at zero behind the same slow bridge, paying full time and compute per identity while an honest agent pays once. Time-locked vesting turns identity count into a cost, not a multiplier.
